lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white line segments are visible across the lateral torso; spacing is largely uniform with a marginal increase in inter-stripe distance in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation identified at the dorsal terminus of the 5th and 6th stripes (counting from anterior), which merge into a single point; a secondary Y-shaped split is observed in the mid-section of the 8th stripe.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple dashed segments are present, specifically the 1st, 3rd, and 10th stripes, which terminate mid-torso and do not reach the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper haunch and pelvic region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-thigh of the hind limb exhibit a clear vertical alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent sub-orbital white spot and two white spots on the lateral muzzle; high-contrast white horizontal band located on the anterior carpus of the forelimb.
